I searched CPRD for hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) and found 15 codes to include.

### Hidradenitis suppurativa codelist

| Code | Term | Notes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| M25y1 | Hidradenitis | Main code for HS (the parent of M25y1-1) |
| M25y1-1 | Hidradenitis suppurativa | |
| EGTON66 | Hydradenitis suppurativa | Alternative spelling |
| ^ESCTSU346454 | Suppurative hidradenitis | |
| ^ESCTHI346451 | Hidradenitis axillaris | |
| ^ESCTVE346453 | Verneuil's disease | Another name for HS |
| ^ESCTAX667047 | Axillary hidradenitis suppurativa | |
| ^ESCTAN667048 | Anogenital hidradenitis suppurativa | |
| ^ESCTVU667049 | Vulval hidradenitis suppurativa | |
| ^ESCT1501708 | Hidradenitis suppurativa of multiple sites | |
| ^ESCTRE667046 | Retro-auricular cysts (hidradenitis) | Behind-the-ear form of HS |
| ^ESCTFO669402 | Follicular occlusion triad - hidradenitis, acne conglobata, dissecting cellulitis of scalp | The term itself names HS |
| ^ESCTFO669403 | Follicular occlusion triad | Includes HS by definition |
| ^ESCTFO669405 | Follicular occlusion tetrad | Includes HS by definition (the triad plus pilonidal sinus) |

### Codes left out
| Code | Term | Reason |
|:--|:--|:--|
| ^ESCTNE512593 | Neutrophilic eccrine hidradenitis | A separate disease, often caused by drugs, not HS |
| M25yX / Myu6D / Myu6J | Apocrine sweat disorder, unspecified / Other apocrine sweat disorders / Disorder of apocrine gland | Too vague to mean HS |
| M25y0, M25y2–M25y6, M25yz | Other sweat gland disorders (e.g., Fox-Fordyce disease, bromhidrosis) | Different conditions |

**Notes:**
- **Codes you may want to drop:** the two follicular occlusion triad/tetrad codes (^ESCTFO669403 and ^ESCTFO669405) don't name HS in the term itself. Remove them if you want a stricter list.
- **Searches with no results:** "acne inversa", "Hurley" (the HS severity score), "sweat gland abscess" and "sweat gland infect" found nothing. "Apocrine" found only unrelated terms.
